name: Grind loop

template.title: Grind loop
template.summary: A fast builder works against the test suite until it passes, bounded by rounds and minutes.
template.whenToUse: Done and good are the same: tests, types or a task list supply the back pressure, so a passing check is the finish line.
template.notFor: Work where passing tests is not the same as good (taste, design, prose); use review-gate or taste-polish there.

slots.ask: What should be built or changed? One or two sentences a builder can act on.
slots.example: Add a slugify(text) function to src/strings.ts that lowercases, strips accents and joins words with single hyphens.

description: A builder changes the code and a check runs the tests. A failure goes back to the builder with the test output; a pass ends the run. The check is the bar, so there is no critic. The loop stops after five rounds or thirty minutes if the tests never pass.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Make the task true by changing the code, adding tests where they are missing. Do not skip, weaken or delete a test to get a pass. On a later round, start from the failing output you are handed. Report what you changed and which tests now pass.
outputs: CHANGES.md: what changed this round and why

check.pass: exit code 0 and no test skipped
